operator_io_quirks: All tables tiny (6-15 rows); original_values lists are short, so rng.choices(k=min(5,len)) often returns near-duplicates.

DDL has a syntax quirk: club_rank CREATE TABLE lacks a comma between PRIMARY KEY (...) and FOREIGN KEY (...); sqlite_master stores it as-is, so replaying DDL verbatim may fail to create the table — must survive (upstream asserts).
FK columns named Club_ID_1/Club_ID_2 in competition_result reference club(Club_ID); parent column name differs from child name, so pragma foreign_key_list gives explicit parent col (not NULL).
competition_result has composite PK (Competition_ID, Club_ID_1, Club_ID_2) and 3 FKs; two FKs point to the same parent table club.
club_rank composite PK (Rank, Club_ID) where Club_ID is also an FK to club — PK member that is FK.
Declared types are INT/REAL/TEXT (uppercase); ts_fuzzer dispatch is case-insensitive on lowercased type.
Start_year is TEXT storing 4-digit years ('2009'); Year is REAL storing 2006.0 — text-stored dates vs numeric year.
Goals is TEXT storing fractions like '50/60','0/1' and '0' — mixed numeric/fraction strings.
Score is TEXT storing '11:10' style scores (colon-separated).
All columns notnull=0, null_rate=0.0 — no NULLs in original, but schema permits them.
Bronze has distinct=4 < rows=6 (ties/duplicates present); Year distinct=2, Competition_type distinct=2 — low-cardinality columns.
Table names/columns are mixed case (Club_ID, Player_ID, Competition_ID); must double-quote in generated SQL.
operator_ts_expectations: Number fuzzer on INT/REAL columns: uniform in [-10^scale,10^scale] (scale from type args; none given so default), then +-1/+-2 perturbation for ints, +-0.01/+-0.02 for floats — produces implausible Club_ID/Player_ID/Apps/Points values (FN source).
String fuzzer on name/Region/Position/Country/Competition_type: random a-zA-Z0-9() strings with contamination — implausible names (FN source).
Start_year (TEXT) gets String fuzzer, not Date — random strings, so year-range predicates miss (FN).
Goals (TEXT fractions) gets String fuzzer — '50/60' style values not reproduced; ratio predicates miss.
Score (TEXT '11:10') gets String fuzzer — colon scores not reproduced.
Year (REAL) gets Number fuzzer — random floats, not 2006/2007; year equality/range predicates miss (FN).
FK columns (Club_ID, Club_ID_1/2, Competition_ID) draw from parent's final values with replacement — ties/duplicates likely, but parent tables tiny (6-11 rows) so FK coverage limited.
Composite PK (Rank,Club_ID) and (Competition_ID,Club_ID_1,Club_ID_2): sample_fresh_primary_keys drops duplicate tuples; with tiny sizes many rows dropped.
club_rank DDL missing comma may cause write_instance_sqlite to fail creating the table (rows_failed) — upstream asserts on DDL replay.
Low-cardinality columns (Year, Competition_type, Bronze) — TS random values won't preserve the 2-value / tie structure (FP from missing ties).
All tables tiny; choose_table_sizes may produce sizes >> original (up to 2500), so generated instances are much larger than original — join cardinalities differ (FP/FN).
No NOT NULL/CHECK enforced in Python; rows violating PK/unique dropped at insert — silent row loss.
